title: REDUX
description: This mod overhauls Minecraft to capture the nostalgic feel of classic versions while seamlessly integrating modern features. The project is currently under active development, with more content on the way.
body:
This mod overhauls Minecraft to capture the nostalgic feel of classic versions while seamlessly integrating new features. The project is currently under active development, with more content on the way.


Important: If minecraft uses default textures (Main menu looks like usual for example), make sure to move the mod's resource pack above the Default Minecraft resources in your Resource Packs settings.
